changes.comment: Adopt the fgv model-alias registry for xAI: the xai-grok descriptor now carries an aliases map (@xai-grok:standard -> grok-4.3, @xai-grok:flagship -> grok-4.5, @xai-grok:imagine -> grok-imagine-image-quality) with a new advanced tier targeting grok-4.5; grok-4.5 is detected as thinking-capable by the default capability config and added to XAiThinkingModelNames.
